stem.text: Maleic acid is used in the food industry and for stabilising drugs. It is the *cis*-isomer of butenedioic acid and has the structural formula $\text{HO}_2\text{CCH=CHCO}_2\text{H}$.
What is the product formed from the reaction of maleic acid with cold, dilute, acidified manganate(VII) ions?
